title: The bigger picture
focus: 目标 · 价值 · 程度 · 优势 · 过程 · 趋势 · 观点 · 说到底
body:
Words for stepping back: goals, values, trends and where you stand. Sentences recycle the news and tech words from L22 and L23, and 客观 and 争论 from L17.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 目标 | mùbiāo | goal / target | the mark your eye fixes on |
| 价值 | jiàzhí | value / worth | price + worth |
| 程度 | chéngdù | degree / extent | how far along the scale |
| 优势 | yōushì | advantage over others / competitive edge | a superior position → edge |
| 过程 | guòchéng | process (the course of something) | the route you pass along |
| 趋势 | qūshì | trend / tendency | momentum heading somewhere |
| 观点 | guāndiǎn | point of view / viewpoint (a stated position on an issue) | a viewing point → stated position |
| 说到底 | shuō dàodǐ | at the end of the day / ultimately | speaking down to the bottom |

## Which word?

**优势 vs 优点 (L11):** 优点 is a good quality on its own; 优势 is an edge over others.

**观点 vs 看法:** 观点 is a stated position on an issue; 看法 is your everyday take.

## Sentences

- 先定目标，再看看自己的优势。 xiān dìng mùbiāo, zài kànkan zìjǐ de yōushì: Set a goal first, then work out where your edge is.
- 人工智能是未来的趋势，挡不住的。 réngōng zhìnéng shì wèilái de qūshì, dǎng bú zhù de: AI is the trend of the future; there's no stopping it.
- 他的观点很客观，我基本同意。 tā de guāndiǎn hěn kèguān, wǒ jīběn tóngyì: His point of view is quite objective; I mostly agree.
- 说到底，你最大的优势是经验。 shuō dàodǐ, nǐ zuì dà de yōushì shì jīngyàn: At the end of the day, your biggest edge is experience.
- 别光盯着目标，过程本身也有价值。 bié guāng dīngzhe mùbiāo, guòchéng běnshēn yě yǒu jiàzhí: Don't just fixate on the goal; the process itself has value too.
- 物价涨到这个程度，政府该管管了。 wùjià zhǎng dào zhège chéngdù, zhèngfǔ gāi guǎnguan le: With prices up to this level, the government should step in.
- 数据显示，年轻人租房已经成了趋势。 shùjù xiǎnshì, niánqīngrén zūfáng yǐjīng chéng le qūshì: The data shows renting has become the trend among young people.
- 说到底，观点不同很正常，何必争论？ shuō dàodǐ, guāndiǎn bù tóng hěn zhèngcháng, hébì zhēnglùn: At the end of the day, different views are normal, so why bother arguing?

cards.Example: 我今年的目标是存够十万块。 wǒ jīnnián de mùbiāo shì cún gòu shí wàn kuài: My goal this year is to save 100,000 yuan
cards.Notes: 目 mù eye (题目, 目光; a pictograph of an eye) + 标 biāo mark (标准) = the mark your eye is fixed on: a target. 目标 = a concrete target; 目的 (的 dì = bullseye) = the purpose behind an action.

cards.Example: 这些老照片对我很有价值。 zhèxiē lǎo zhàopiàn duì wǒ hěn yǒu jiàzhí: These old photos are very valuable to me
cards.Notes: 价 jià price (价格, 价钱) + 值 zhí worth (值得, 值钱) = what something is worth. 价值观 = one's values (观 view, 观点); 价格 = price.

cards.Example: 问题严重到什么程度了？ wèntí yánzhòng dào shénme chéngdù le: How serious has the problem gotten?
cards.Notes: 程 chéng measure, stage (过程, 路程) + 度 dù degree (温度, 速度) = how far along the scale. Also level of education: 文化程度. Shares 程 with 过程.

cards.Example: 你的优势是会说两种语言。 nǐ de yōushì shì huì shuō liǎng zhǒng yǔyán: Your edge is that you speak two languages
cards.Notes: 优 yōu excellent (优秀) + 势 shì force, position (形势, 气势) = a superior position. Mirror: 劣势 disadvantage. 优势 = an advantage over others; 优点 = a good quality.

cards.Example: 学语言是个慢慢积累的过程。 xué yǔyán shì ge mànmàn jīlěi de guòchéng: Learning a language is a slow process of building up
cards.Notes: 过 guò pass (经过, 过去) + 程 chéng route, stage (路程, 课程) = the route you pass along. 过程 = how something unfolds; 流程 (流 flow) = a set procedure or workflow. Shares 程 with 程度.

cards.Example: 房价有下降的趋势。 fángjià yǒu xiàjiàng de qūshì: Housing prices are trending down
cards.Notes: 趋 qū hurry toward, 走 walk radical (趋向) + 势 shì force, momentum (形势, 姿势) = momentum heading somewhere. 趋势 = a direction of change; 潮流 (潮 tide + 流 flow) = a fashion or cultural trend.

cards.English: point of view / viewpoint (a stated position on an issue)
cards.Example: 我不太同意你的观点。 wǒ bú tài tóngyì nǐ de guāndiǎn: I don't really agree with your point of view
cards.Notes: 观 guān view, look at (参观, 观众) + 点 diǎn point, dot (一点, 重点) = a viewing point: where you look at an issue from, so a stated opinion. Family: 客观/主观, 乐观/悲观 all share 观. vs 看法 = the everyday 'take' (你怎么看?).

cards.English: at the end of the day / ultimately
cards.Example: 说到底，还是钱的问题。 shuō dàodǐ, háishi qián de wèntí: At the end of the day, it's about money
cards.Notes: 说 say + 到底 dàodǐ to the bottom (到 reach + 底 bottom, 底下; also 你到底去不去？) = speaking down to the bottom: ultimately. 归根结底 (return to the root, end at the bottom) is the formal version.

cards.English: Set a goal first, then work out where your edge is.
cards.Hanzi: 先定目标，再看看自己的优势。
cards.Pinyin: xiān dìng mùbiāo, zài kànkan zìjǐ de yōushì.
cards.Notes: 目标 (L24) + 优势 (L24). 先…再… = first … then …

cards.English: AI is the trend of the future; there's no stopping it.
cards.Hanzi: 人工智能是未来的趋势，挡不住的。
cards.Pinyin: réngōng zhìnéng shì wèilái de qūshì, dǎng bú zhù de.
cards.Notes: 趋势 (L24) + 人工智能 (L23). 挡不住 = can't be held back.

cards.English: His point of view is quite objective; I mostly agree.
cards.Hanzi: 他的观点很客观，我基本同意。
cards.Pinyin: tā de guāndiǎn hěn kèguān, wǒ jīběn tóngyì.
cards.Notes: 观点 (L24) + 客观 (L17) + 同意 (L1). 基本 = basically, mostly.

cards.English: At the end of the day, your biggest edge is experience.
cards.Hanzi: 说到底，你最大的优势是经验。
cards.Pinyin: shuō dàodǐ, nǐ zuì dà de yōushì shì jīngyàn.
cards.Notes: 说到底 (L24) + 优势 (L24) + 经验 (L4).

cards.English: Don't just fixate on the goal; the process itself has value too.
cards.Hanzi: 别光盯着目标，过程本身也有价值。
cards.Pinyin: bié guāng dīngzhe mùbiāo, guòchéng běnshēn yě yǒu jiàzhí.
cards.Notes: 目标 (L24) + 过程 (L24) + 价值 (L24). 光 = only, just.

cards.English: With prices up to this level, the government should step in.
cards.Hanzi: 物价涨到这个程度，政府该管管了。
cards.Pinyin: wùjià zhǎng dào zhège chéngdù, zhèngfǔ gāi guǎnguan le.
cards.Notes: 程度 (L24) + 物价 (L22) + 政府 (L22). V到这个程度 = got to this point.

cards.English: The data shows renting has become the trend among young people.
cards.Hanzi: 数据显示，年轻人租房已经成了趋势。
cards.Pinyin: shùjù xiǎnshì, niánqīngrén zūfáng yǐjīng chéng le qūshì.
cards.Notes: 趋势 (L24) + 数据 (L23) + 租房 (L21). 显示 = show (data, a screen).

cards.English: At the end of the day, different views are normal, so why bother arguing?
cards.Hanzi: 说到底，观点不同很正常，何必争论？
cards.Pinyin: shuō dàodǐ, guāndiǎn bù tóng hěn zhèngcháng, hébì zhēnglùn?
cards.Notes: 说到底 (L24) + 观点 (L24) + 何必 (L3) + 争论 (L17).
